method: Source-specific research reads, claim locators (paraphrases unless literal excerpt identified), and local computed evidence; not blanket certification.

sources.title: Official task, distance-weighted Tversky and submission format
sources.excerpt: For this competition, we set alpha=0.2 and beta=0.8
sources.supports: False-positive and false-negative weights; 300m triangular kernel; max probability-kernel TP; EPSG:32611/100m/single-band float32/[0,1]/null-or-NaN outside.

sources.title: Competition objective and two prize rounds
sources.excerpt: The same submission is scored twice
sources.supports: Initial private test, then expert-expanded fault labels; deadline Dec 3 2026 23:59 UTC; total pool $300,000.
sources.limits: Fault discovery is not proof of vents or a drillable geothermal reservoir; eligibility and final entry require entrant certification.

sources.title: Organizer: exact catalogue mask, new-fault credit only
sources.excerpt: The mask is indeed pixel-exact - it is identical to the provided set of training fault labels.
sources.supports: Only new-fault ground truth scores; proximity to a known trace gives no wrong-label exemption; new labels may be within 300m of known traces.
sources.limits: The public website's full server evaluator is not released; our implementation matches published math and staff-confirmed mask behavior.
sources.verification: Read staff post #4, not just a participant interpretation.

sources.title: Organizer: rolling submission allowance
sources.excerpt: The submission allowance resets based on a rolling window, not at a specific date and time.
sources.supports: Rolling window; three submissions per week comes from rules sections 3.2/3.4.
sources.limits: This project does not know your account's already-used slots.
sources.verification: Read staff response and official rules.

sources.title: GEMS Official Rules, September 2026
sources.authority: DOE / National Laboratory of the Rockies
sources.excerpt: Using generative AI technology in the development of your prize submission is allowed. However, you must indicate in the narrative ... the extent
sources.supports: Single 100m GeoTIFF entry; one final submission across both rounds; external rights/reproducibility/eligibility and AI disclosure.

sources.title: Organizer declines to disclose new-label selection
sources.excerpt: We're not sharing details about the data sources, fault types, or coverage behind the test faults beyond what's in the problem description.
sources.supports: Do not assume experts used only lidar, sampled all locations equally, or mapped only surface scarps.
sources.limits: Known-fault hide/recover cannot reproduce the hidden catalogue selection distribution.
sources.verification: Read staff post #7.

sources.title: INGENIOUS regional datasets (DOI 10.15121/1881483)
sources.authority: DOE Geothermal Data Repository / UNR collaborators
sources.excerpt: These datasets are provided as is ... may be redistributed with attribution
sources.supports: Free public CC-BY 4.0 well/spring chemistry, 2m probes, paleo-geothermal features, faults, geodetics, volcanics; links to MT/heat-flow/gravity data.
sources.limits: Joined observations are not independent sites; anomalies are not proof of a local unknown fault. Full-catalogue orphan distances cannot enter a hide/recover model.
sources.verification: Read dataset description, resources and terms; derived transport CSV audited locally.

sources.supports: Magnetic and radiometric surveys for geological mapping; cited as reference 3 in the official prize rules.
sources.limits: Geophysical edges may reflect lithology, magnetization or acquisition seams, not displacement.

sources.excerpt: a provisional regional gravity grid ... a regional magnetic grid ... a regional depth-to-basement grid
sources.supports: Physical layer origins and regional structural context.
sources.limits: Regional resolution/interpolation cannot locate every small fault to 100m; depth-to-basement is not the same as the MT depth-to-conductive-base variable.

sources.title: Joint geophysical imaging of geothermal systems
sources.authority: USGS-authored paper, Peacock et al.; DOE OSTI repository
sources.excerpt: other information needs to be incorporated, including geological mapping, rock property information, and other geophysical constraints
sources.supports: Gravity measures density contrast; magnetic anomalies locate structures AND lithologic contacts; MT is complementary but ambiguous. Joint evidence motivates, not validates, H21-1.
sources.limits: No claim that our transform or coefficients are in this paper; those are registered research proposals.
sources.verification: Read abstract/introduction and specific Great Basin discussion.

sources.title: Access NHDPlus HR hydrography products
sources.excerpt: As of October 1, 2023, the NHD was retired ... no longer maintained
sources.supports: Historical NHDPlus HR vector/raster downloads and map services; newer data through 3DHP. Specific product/footprint availability must be checked.
sources.limits: A catalogue landing page is not proof of obtaining a footprint-covering flowline file. No H21-2 validation yet.
sources.verification: Read download directories and retirement notice.

sources.title: 2026 GeMS version of SGMC
sources.excerpt: Map Scale: 1:1,000,000
sources.supports: 2026 GeMS release and unit-polygon context; legacy Nevada/California state ZIPs remain linked by USGS.
sources.limits: Coarse scale, imperfect boundary reconciliation; do not use fault-line layer as a held-out model input. Exact downloaded version needs a hash.
sources.verification: Read NGMDB product 119417 and ScienceBase recommendation to use the 2026 release.

sources.title: Conductive heat flow and residual point data
sources.excerpt: the residual ... may be useful in identifying hydrothermal or groundwater influence on conductive heat flow
sources.supports: DOI 10.5066/P9BZPVUC; CC0; background maps deliberately downweight convectively influenced outliers. An already-published residual layer is a useful next source to investigate.
sources.limits: Residual does not uniquely diagnose local fault-mediated advection; not downloaded/used in H21-1.
sources.verification: Read official data release description.

sources.title: Thermal conductivity measurement/source quality
sources.excerpt: Thermal conductivity (TC) data taken for different wells at a specified drill depth.
sources.supports: CC-BY 4.0 spreadsheet with measured/assumed/unmeasured source classes; DOI 10.15121/1874222.
sources.limits: Do not treat assumed conductivity as measured; well-depth/temperature matching still required for H21-4.
sources.verification: Read official resource and measurement-quality definitions.

sources.title: Non-negative positive–unlabeled risk estimator
sources.authority: Kiryo, Niu, du Plessis, Sugiyama; NIPS 2017 primary research
sources.excerpt: we propose a non-negative risk estimator for PU learning
sources.supports: Learning with positives/unlabeled samples without assuming absent labels are negative.
sources.limits: Our fixed prior .03 and SCAR assumptions are unverified for biased fault catalogues. No calibrated probability claim.
